title: Foghorn Leghorn
blurb: A blustering, oversized Southern rooster ceaselessly antagonized by a dim-witted dog and a persistent baby chicken hawk in his Looney Tunes shorts.
facts: He was created by Robert McKimson, and starred in 29 cartoons from 1946 to 1964 in the golden age of American animation.
All 29 of these cartoons were directed by McKimson.
